title: Specialist Leader, AI and Analytics at a Technology Consulting Firm Expects Oracle-Related Business Growth to Accelerate Through 2027
expert: Specialist Leader, AI and Analytics at a global technology consulting firm and Oracle alliance partner; Fortune 500 and large enterprises in North America
verdict: In a large Oracle partner practice, OCI business grew 25%–30% and applications 12%–14% y/y in Sep–Nov with renewals at 110%–112% of last year, while deal cycles stretched to 90–120 days from 60–90.

IaaS growth vs consensus: 🟢 **OCI business +25%–30% y/y in Sep–Nov** in the practice (first-hand); consistent with UBS checks of no systemic capacity delays (SB #66105). → Tenet 1 (OCI RPO conversion) ↑
🟢 **AI infrastructure adoption +15%–20% q/q; 10%–15% of customers on consumption-based AI** (first-hand); first read. → Tenet 1 (OCI RPO conversion) ↑
Pricing & margins: 🟡 **Aggregate prices +3%–4% y/y** across licenses, subscriptions and OCI (first-hand) vs Deutsche Bank checks of 10–40% cloud-service increases (SB #63354): **conflicting**. → Tenet 4 (build-out margins) →
🔴 **Deal cycles 90–120 days vs 60–90 before** (first-hand); first read.
Apps & database: 🟢 **Applications +12%–14% y/y, renewals at 110%–112% of prior year** (first-hand); first read. → Tenet 5 (apps & database) ↑
🟡 **Winning SAP ECC pipeline ahead of the early-2027 deadline; lost one decision-support database workload to Google Cloud**; first read. → Tenet 5 (apps & database) →

changes: OCI demand: practice OCI business +25%–30% y/y vs UBS checks with 23 customers/partners showing no systemic delays on 6+GW coming online (SB #66105, 2026-11-04): **consistent**.
Pricing: blended prices +3%–4% y/y vs Deutsche Bank checks of 10–40% increases on cloud services, up to 2x for Sovereign/DRCC (SB #63354, 2026-10-19): **conflicting** (blended vs cloud-only scope).

Consumption AI uptake: 10%–15% of customers on consumption-based AI vs UBS partner check that fewer than 5 of 400+ customers bought the $500k minimum-spend Fusion AI package (SB #67343, 2026-11-04): different measures; **partly conflicting**.
First read on deal-cycle length (90–120 days vs 60–90); no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (OCI RPO conversion): ↑ — OCI +25%–30% y/y and AI infrastructure adoption +15%–20% q/q in a Fortune 500 partner practice.
Tenet 4 (build-out margins): → — prices +3%–4% y/y, far below the 10–40% cloud increases in other checks.
Tenet 5 (apps & database): ↑ — applications +12%–14%, renewals 110%–112%, SAP ECC pipeline; offset by one database workload lost to Google Cloud.
